statement: A directory containing docforge.yaml with schema docforge.project.v1 opens through the CLI and desktop workbench.
A general project using document.md and docforge-standard completes inspect, validate, review, and build without academic metadata.
An academic project supplies a typed optional academic profile and builds without imposing those fields on general projects.
Obsolete manifest, command, aggregate, package, BuildReport, and workbench protocol identities are absent or rejected.
Default source, build, and Review paths use document.md and neutral document output names.
Project paths reject absolute, remote, traversal, and symlink-escape inputs while accepting safe relative resources.
The Markdown to ForgeDocument to RenderPlan to DOCX pipeline is deterministic, ordered, cancelable, and atomic.
CLI, HTTP, Tauri, and frontend fixtures use one versioned DocForge protocol with matching identities.
The installed macOS workbench uses neutral DocForge terminology and produces a valid Microsoft Word final preview.
Repository-owned examples, fixtures, active documentation, packaging, and CI use DocForge contracts and neutral filenames.
